nodes.npcLine: A colossal Sphinx blocks the vault entrance. Its eyes gleam. 'Only the wise may pass. Answer my riddles, or perish.'
Riddle the First: 'I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?'
The Sphinx snarls. 'Wrong. You have failed once. Two chances remain.'
Riddle the Second: 'I am always hungry, I must always be fed. The finger I touch will soon turn red. What am I?'
The Sphinx growls. 'Wrong again. Only one chance remains.'
Riddle the Third: 'I am not alive, but I grow. I have no lungs, yet I need air. I have no mouth, yet water kills me. What am I?'
The Sphinx roars. 'Three failures! Your ignorance is your doom!'
The Sphinx bows its head. 'You have answered wisely. The scroll vaults are open to you.'
The Sphinx gives you the vault key, and steps aside. 'Take what knowledge you dare. Few have passed this trial.'
You flee from the Sphinx, its laughter echoing behind you. The vault remains sealed.
The Sphinx watches silently as you depart. 'Return only if you seek wisdom.'
